story_title: FracPro Live+ - Reports - Load and display Real-time and FracPro channel selections
description: As a Live+ user, I want to view and modify the Real-time and FracPro channels included in the ASCII report so that I can control the report content.
ac_texts: On opening the dialog, invoke the GET reportSetup API . The dialog shall contain two tabs: Real-time Columns: # Channel Select Display all Real-time channels. Display a checkbox for eh channel. Display a header checkbox to Select FracPro Columns: # Channel Select Display all FracPro channels. Display a checkbox for each channel. Display a header checkbox to Select . If asciirealtime is returned with values, only those channels shall be selected. If asciirealtime is missing or empty, all Real-time channels shall be selected by default. If asciifp is returned with values, only those channels shall be selected. If asciifp is missing or empty, no FracPro channels shall be selected by default. Users shall be able to modify individual channel selections.
code_validation_rules: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed or rejected
